required_concepts: π (pi) as the ratio of circumference to diameter
acceptable_paraphrases: Length of ribbon needed for a single wrap
critical_errors: Using an incorrect formula, such as area or volume of a circle
misconceptions: thinking ribbon needs to be wrapped multiple times around the cake
calculating the surface area of the cake instead of its circumference
grading_notes: round the answer to one decimal place or provide a value between 62.8 and 63 cm
